name: M6.Euclid.binary_normalization
statement: ∀ p : M6.Euclid.BP, (p ≠ 0 → p.Monic) ∧ normalize p = p
guidance: Every binary leading coefficient is0 or1, by ordinary decide over ZMod2. Nonzero p has nonzero leadingCoeff, hence1. Use Polynomial.Monic.normalize_eq_self; handle zero separately. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve the exact frozen statement and default compiler/axiom limits.
